_comment: Player-facing clue artifacts rendered in the Clue Browser (public/browser.html). These are the fake social media posts, profiles, and research papers a social engineer would 'find'. Abstraction ramps with difficulty: easy = direct, medium = less specific, hard = subtle with NO giveaway hints. Operator-only extra hints for hard accounts live in data/operator-notes.json (not served to players).

artifacts.body: My username is my hero name joined by an underscore: **captain_cyber**. In person I'm just a proud Texan! 🤠
My password is two words stuck together — a **Star** that gives a **Shield** — then the number **99** right after. ⭐🛡️99
My pet flies higher than anyone. It blasts off like it's headed to space! 🚀 Best buddy ever.
Born and raised in the home of NASA! 'Houston, we have a problem' hits different when it's your hometown. 🏙️
They call me 'prof' for short. Teaching the next generation about retro games! My handle is **prof** and **pixel** joined by a dot: **prof.pixel** 🕹️
My password: the number **8**, then the word **bit**, then the word **World** — all stuck together. Classic retro resolution! 🎮
Nothing beats my favorite arcade game — a yellow circle chomping dots and running from ghosts! 👻🟡
Throwback to my first school — Pixel Academy! Named after the tiny dots on a screen, just like me. 📺
I think in ones and zeros! My username is my first name and last name joined by an underscore: **betty_binary**. 0101
My password spells it out: the word **Zero**, then the digit **1**, then the word **One**, then the digit **0** — all together. 💾
My cat has a number name — it's the digit that isn't zero! The one between zero and two. 🐱
Favorite food is round, cheesy, comes in slices and has two Z's in its name. 🍕 Yum!
Out running again after dark. The night is when I feel most alive. 🌙
Mom's family name always made me think of a dark forest — a color and what trees are made of, together. 🌲
Grew up on a street named after a tree. I loved being the captain at the **helm** on that wooden playground.
Favorite color? Mix red and blue and you've got it. The color of royalty. 👑
Find me online under the handle on this profile. I fix the bugs nobody else can. 🐛🔧

artifacts.title: On the Elimination of Software Defects by Direct Compression
artifacts.abstract: My pet is named after the smallest unit of data made of eight bits — it sounds like something you do with your teeth. In this study we examine squashing bugs one at a time.

Studied in a big Massachusetts city — famous for a tea party and the Red Sox. ☕⚾
Keep it simple — just use my first name to find me. I block everything that comes my way! 🚫
Born in the city they call 'windy.' Deep dish pizza by the lake, nothing better. 🍕🌬️
New ride! Same color as a fire truck and a rose. 🚗 Love it.
My lucky number is the one most people pick — right between 6 and 8. 🎲

acct7.name: Cipher Queen
acct7._note: HARD: nothing is stated outright. Username/password never spelled out. Answers (Cryptwell, Enigma, Colorado, 2010) are buried in story and one near-match word in the news piece.

artifacts.title: Ten Years On, Still a Mile Above Everything
artifacts.author: C.Q.
artifacts.body: I moved up into the Rockies right out of school and never looked back. The license plates here, the thin air, the way Denver glitters at the foot of the range — it gets into you. This month my old class threw a reunion; it stunned me to count the rings and realize a full decade had turned over since we tossed our caps the year the twenty-tens began. Funny how a place that keeps so many secrets can also feel like home.

artifacts.title: Stuck tracing my mother's side — the family is weirdly secretive
artifacts.body: Her maiden line is impossible. Every record just points to the old family plot out past the farm — a cold stone resting-place up on the hill, and right beside it this ancient stone shaft they drew water from for generations. The two things sit together in every photo, like the name itself was built out of both.

replies.body: Old surnames did exactly that — smash two landmarks on the property into one word. What's near the grave site?
A deep well. Been there two hundred years. Grandma said the name 'came up out of the ground with the water.'

artifacts.headline: Regional Cryptography Club Hosts Annual Puzzle Night
artifacts.preview: Attendees gathered downtown for an evening of trivia, raffle prizes, and lukewarm coffee. Organizers thanked the volunteers, the catering team, and the parking attendants. One longtime member, described by friends as quiet and **enigmatic**, declined an interview but did win the door prize, a gift card nobody remembered donating. The event ran long and the chairs were uncomfortable.

artifacts.body: Still think about my very first pet all the time. Back then I named everything after codebreaking machines from the old war films — this one more than earned the title. 🧩

acct8.name: Zero Day Zach
acct8._note: HARD: nothing stated outright. Answers (Surfing, Exploit, Hackers, Malibu) buried in story; one near-match word for the beach in the news piece.

artifacts.title: Lives on my roof rack now
artifacts.author: Z.Z.
artifacts.body: Out on the water before sunrise every single day, this thing carves like a dream. Only downside: my dog chewed the leash on day one. Fitting, honestly — I named him after the thing you unleash once you've found a crack in someone's defenses, the payload you fire through the gap. He takes advantage of every weakness in my fence too. 10/10 board, 2/10 dog behavior, would still ride at dawn forever.

movie night at Z's again lol. he made us rewatch that grungy 1995 cult flick about teenage kids breaking into systems with dial-up modems. the title is literally just... what they are. he quotes every line. 💻

artifacts.headline: Beach Cleanup Draws Dozens Despite Gray Skies
artifacts.preview: Volunteers collected bags of litter, posed for photos, and enjoyed free lemonade. The turnout was described as moderate. A local said the sand felt especially **malleable** underfoot this season, which experts attributed to tides. Organizers reminded everyone to reapply sunscreen and reminded them again twenty minutes later.

artifacts.title: Found: Surf Leash + Dog Tag
artifacts.body: Picked up a chewed board leash near the famous celebrity beach up the coast from L.A. — the glitzy one the magazines won't stop writing about. Attached dog tag just says a single security-world word meaning 'the move that cashes in on a flaw.' Owner clearly spends every morning in the water. Come claim it.

acct9.name: Jannett
acct9._note: HARD: she is private; almost nothing from her directly. Answers (grad 1997, Pizza, T-Rex, pet named Bunny) come from a reunion blog, an event RSVP, a classified, and a friend's mention. Password pieces (pet name + birth year 1989) are implied, never stated.

artifacts.title: Our Big Reunion Writeup
artifacts.author: Reunion Committee
artifacts.body: What a night! Hard to believe it's been this long since the Class of '97 walked the stage. A few of us did the math over dinner — most of the group was born in the back half of the eighties, give or take, so you can imagine the playlist. Jannett came out, which surprised everyone since she keeps to herself these days; she mostly talked about her pet and where to find the best slice near the convention district downtown.

artifacts.title: Midweek Meetup — Downtown Bites
artifacts.where: The corner spot by the Conference Center (you know the one — boxes, cheese, triangles)
artifacts.body: Casual hang. First round of the usual cheesy, round, sliced favorite is on the group.

artifacts.title: Lost: One Very Large 'Lap' Dinosaur
artifacts.body: Missing from the yard: the king of the lizards himself — enormous jaws, comically tiny arms, you can't miss him. Despite being the fiercest thing that ever lived, I gave him the softest, floppiest-eared, carrot-munching name imaginable (think hop-hop, not chomp-chomp). He answers only to that cuddly name. Reward offered.

ran into Jannett downtown!! still obsessed with that giant dino of hers and STILL calls the big scary thing by that sweet little floppy-eared, hops-around-the-garden name 😂 some things never change since school.
